parsed.rationale: Both participating records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is limited to the alias declaration shape itself rather than any substantive shared logic. The two types — `AsyncNotificationMessageSequence.AsyncIterator` in `AsyncMessage.swift` and `MainActorNotificationMessageSequence.AsyncIterator` in `MainActorMessage.swift` — are nested type aliases that exist to satisfy the `AsyncIteratorProtocol` requirement of their respective parent sequence types, which encode distinct concurrency semantics (main-actor-isolated vs. unconstrained). Collapsing or extracting them would conflate those distinct concurrency domains without any meaningful deduplication benefit.
